sections.heading: Code changes become reviewable evidence
sections.text: Scheduled scans compare referenced source regions and identify every affected diagram and step.

steps.text: The shared scanner runs weekday mornings at 08:23 America/New_York, or on manual dispatch.
Read the checked-in registry, registered specs, code reference pins and prior drift decisions.
Read immutable source blobs at the reviewed pin and the current source default-branch revision through the API.
Locate each unique literal anchor range and compare its text. Unrelated line movement alone is ignored.
Changed anchored text identifies every affected diagram and step. This still does not establish behavioral impact.
Create or reuse one evidence PR for the changed reference scope, plus Markdown/JSON reports and an Actions summary.
If anchored content is unchanged, record a clean scan. No behavioral decision or baseline update is needed.
If source or anchors cannot be resolved, save repair evidence and fail the scan visibly; expected behavior stays unchanged.

sections.heading: A diff asks a question; a human answers
sections.text: No impact, a regression, an intended change, and plain closure have different effects on the approved story.

cells.meaning: Verify the live actor and bot report
Refuse stale or ambiguous source evidence
Require a linked team issue
A refused atomic write leaves canon unchanged

steps.text: The maintainer reads the code diff and every affected diagram/step, then determines whether behavior changed.

gates.note: A report PR is evidence, not automatic behavioral approval.

steps.text: For a harmless change, the maintainer applies flowview/no-impact and closes the report.
The decision runner verifies the report, live actor permission, exact disposition and current evidence before accepting it.
Commit the exact reviewed source pin and audit decision together. The expected narrative stays unchanged.
For a regression, the maintainer links a real team issue, sets flowview/regression and closes the report.
After validating the regression decision, write its audit state while retaining the expected story and accepted source pin.
For intended behavior, revise the spec and source pin in an ordinary PR; an agent may assist the author.
The reviewed spec update changes the approved story and pin together; the next published snapshot is discoverable.
Closing or merging a report with no disposition leaves the baseline unchanged. A later scan reuses that report.

sections.heading: Compare an incident with the expected story
sections.text: An approved reference trace helps map observations onto a canonical flow. An incident creates a separate proposal.

steps.text: Import exported trace JSON and retain only supported operational identity, timing and error attributes.
Match exact service/operation selectors; ambiguous or missing matches remain visible. Do not guess concurrency from timestamps.
Explicitly approve the sanitized reference mapping against the spec revision. Company integration applies real repository review policy.
Read the approved reference and authored expectations before comparing an incident trace.
Supply a new incident trace. Environment mismatches block comparison; missing measurements remain unknown.
Build an isolated alternate at the first differing beat. Preserve only the unchanged prefix and use independent divergent steps.
A human or agent may edit the alternate and propose it through normal spec review; comparison alone never changes canon.

sections.text: backstage-diagrams builds the editor and publishes internal renderer releases. The separate Backstage app adopts a release through its own PR; compatibility metadata explains any gap.

steps.text: In backstage-diagrams, add a panel type in its own module. Reuse shared folding, controls and lifecycle helpers.
Named entrypoints assemble standalone, workbench, backend, native Backstage and Forge artifacts.
Review source changes and run the host tests plus pinned Chromium browser contracts.
Register the feature requirement, bump the renderer release, regenerate artifacts and publish internally.
backstage-diagrams deploys its editor build. Exports stamp each spec with its required renderer features.
Backstage upgrades through its own PR and release. Its installed renderer can show the new capability.
If Backstage is older, show an upgrade notice and supported content. An unsupported contract major prevents rendering.

sections.text: Existing local rehearsal: fictional code, real Backstage and the reference proxy adapter. It proves rendering and drift; the company GitHub spec loader needs its own integration check.

The existing local rehearsal reads fixture specs through its reference proxy adapter. This demonstrates native rendering, not the company GitHub loader.
Create isolated refactor and timeout branches. Each change targets referenced recording code.
The refactor changes referenced text but preserves behavior. The scanner raises evidence for human review.
